```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)


dataDirectory = "Output/Runs"


getCombinedTable <- function(tableName){
    allScenarioNames = list.dirs(dataDirectory)
    allScenarioNames = allScenarioNames[allScenarioNames != dataDirectory]

    totalTable = data.frame()
    for(scenario in allScenarioNames){
        currentTable = read.csv(file.path(scenario,tableName))
        name = strsplit(scenario,"OncoSim-")[[1]][2]
        currentTable$sce = name
        totalTable = bind_rows(totalTable,currentTable)
    }
    return(totalTable)
}



```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: Test Plot



mortalityData = getCombinedTable("Colorectal_Cancer_Cases_Table.csv") %>% filter(Province == "all",Sex=="all",Colorectal_cancer_site == "all", expr_name == "Deaths_cause_specific")

mortalityData = mortalityData %>% group_by(expr_name,Year,sce) %>% summarize(totalValue=sum(expr_value))


ggplot(mortalityData,aes(x=Year,y=totalValue,colour=sce)) + geom_line() +ggtitle("Mortality - Colorectal")


```
